source_text.body:
Use Claude on linked accounts for finance and investing decisions
The poster uses Claude, connected to financial account data through a Plaid wrapper, for personal finances and investing decisions.
·
Feb 1, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster uses Claude by manually uploading recent credit-card transaction histories, account transaction exports, and portfolio screenshots. They ask it to optimize which cards to use for points, identify subscriptions to cancel, and suggest portfolio rebalancing against stated risk thresholds; the main gap they describe is having to keep feeding screenshots and CSVs because they have not found a solid live account sync beyond Plaid-based beta wrappers.
How it went
They say the responses have been better than expected, especially for spending and subscription review. But they still see real-time account data as the blocker, and commenters warn that investment and tax guidance can be wrong or hard to verify.
Worth knowing
The practical catch is time: without a live connection, they say constantly uploading screenshots and CSVs from accounts is very time consuming.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Using my linked accounts, review the last [3-12] months of transactions and current balances and holdings. Give me a summary of where my money goes, my savings rate, any subscriptions or fees I could cut, and how my investments are allocated versus my goal of [goal and time horizon]. Finish with three prioritized, specific actions I could take, and don't move money or change anything in my accounts. I'll make any changes myself.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1qqf7qo/claude_as_a_financial_advisor
